summary: Tested WEDORA vendor marketplace, leads, auth, admin, moodboard export, and chat share (backend + frontend). 14/14 backend tests pass. Most frontend flows work correctly (/for-vendors 3 pricing cards, /vendor/auth register+login, /vendor/dashboard 7 tabs, Overview stat cards + profile completion, Subscription DEMO MODE banner + plan switch, Leads with NEW LEAD badge + Contact/WhatsApp/Mark buttons, /marketplace listing with premium badge on petal-pearl-studio, Request Quote submit, /admin/dashboard with 5 admin-plan-select dropdowns, Moodboard export button becomes visible after design generation, /share/{id} page renders read-only conversation). Found 1 real frontend bug: chat Share toast shows ERROR message even when share_id is created successfully (clipboard write fails in preview iframe and error toast fires despite backend 200 OK).

ui_bugs.issue: Toast shows 'Could not create the share link. Try again.' even when POST /api/chat/share returns 200 with valid share_id. Root cause: navigator.clipboard.writeText throws in the preview iframe / non-secure contexts, which is caught by the outer try/catch and triggers the error toast — masking a successful share creation. Users cannot copy the link. Fix: wrap clipboard call in its own try/catch, and on failure still show success toast with the URL (already passed as description) plus a manual copy fallback.

Testid mismatch with spec. Spec requests data-testid `plan-choose-{plan}` but code uses `sub-choose-{plan}`. Functionally works (plan switch confirmed via current-plan-label update) but breaks any automated test that follows the documented convention. Recommend aliasing to `plan-choose-{plan}` or updating the spec.

action_items: Fix chat share toast: nest navigator.clipboard.writeText() in its own try/catch inside shareChat() so that a clipboard write failure does NOT mask the successful share_id creation. Always show the share URL to the user.
Align testid naming: add data-testid='plan-choose-{plan}' on SubscriptionTab plan buttons (or update spec) to match the documented convention.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1113 lines — approaching maintainability threshold. Consider splitting into routers (auth, vendor, marketplace, admin, chat, share).

vendor_public() omits `stats` — public marketplace/admin listings cannot show any traction metrics (views/leads counters). Fine as-is if intentional, but /admin/vendors should probably include stats for the console.
ChatInterface.shareChat() single try/catch conflates network error with clipboard error — masking success responses (as observed).
make_slug() does not enforce a minimum length after regex — a business_name of only symbols yields 'vendor' every time and then relies on unique_slug() suffixing; acceptable but worth noting.

Chat share endpoint does not require any authentication — anyone who can guess a 12-char share_id can read the conversation. Acceptable for a public share link but there is no rate limit on POST /api/chat/share creation.

rca of the issue: Chat share error toast RCA: In ChatInterface.jsx shareChat(), a single try block wraps BOTH apiCreateShare() and navigator.clipboard.writeText(). In the emergent preview iframe (cross-origin/insecure context), clipboard API throws a DOMException, which the catch handler treats as a share-creation failure and shows 'Could not create the share link.' — even though the POST /api/chat/share succeeded with 200 and a valid share_id. Reproduction: open homepage in preview, send any chat message, wait for AI reply, click chat-share-btn — observe error toast while /api/chat/share returns 200 (verified via network intercept and by successfully loading /share/{share_id} which shows the read-only conversation). Mitigation: split into two try/catch blocks so clipboard failure falls back to displaying the URL and still uses toast.success.
